summary_bullets: Strengthen the plan-review fallback_group harness to verify Cursor/Codex static slot pairing per archetype.
Reuse the zero-findings review-core branch when aggregation succeeds with MERGED_COUNT=0, avoiding voter dispatch for attestation-only empty merges.
Document phase-suffixed aggregator output captures and cover the empty-merge skip behavior in review-core tests.
commit_message:
Skip review voters after empty aggregate merge

Reuse the zero-findings tally and emit path when aggregate-findings reports REASON=ok with MERGED_COUNT=0, so review-core does not launch voters for an attestation-only empty merge. Strengthen the plan-review fallback_group harness and update review-core artifact documentation for phase-suffixed aggregator outputs.
